subject: reasoning
question: After interchanging + & × and 3 & 9, which of the following equations will hold true?
solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png] 

Given:

interchanging + & × and 3 & 9 

Now,checking the given equations, 

**Option 1) (3+5)×9=48**

⇒ (9×5)+3

= (45)+3
= 48

Option 2) (9+2)×3=10

⇒ (3×2)+9

= 6+9
= 15 ≠ 10

Option 3) (3+7)×9=60

⇒ (9×7)+3

= 63+3
= 66 ≠ 60

Option 4) (9+1)×3=15

⇒ (3×1)+9

= 3+9
= 12 ≠ 15

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
